Microsoft is preparing to end support for Windows 10, while wage growth slows in the business sector. Meanwhile, homes insulated under government schemes face repair issues and US-China trade tensions resurface due to new port fees. In tech news, India's Airbound secures funding for drone delivery service, SpaceX achieves a milestone with Starship SN8, and Nvidia launches a personal AI supercomputer. Android phones are found vulnerable to hackers stealing 2FA codes and private messages. Facebook is reintroducing job listings, and the UK regulator fines 4chan for ignoring online safety laws.
